name: matrix truncation
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 按有效参与自由度缩减动态矩阵的处理。
usage_overview: 在移动列车作用下的结构动力计算中，可仅选取列车附近结构的自由度参与时间积分，以缩小求解系统，减少需要积分求解的自由度数量。

complete_examples.text: In this paper an improved modelling method for characterizing slab track-bridge interaction subject to a moving train is proposed, where an innovative matrix truncation method is developed to improve the computational efficiency.

P059.title: Slab track-bridge interaction subjected to a moving train: an improved matrix formulation and truncation method
P059.authors: Q Zhang, X Zhang, L Xu
